full_judgment:
This Rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 3-6-1996 and 10-6-1996 respectively passed by the District Judge, Netrakona in Family Other Appeal No. 186 of 1995 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 7-9- 1995 and 13-9-1995 respectively passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Mohanganj, Netrakona in Family Suit No. 14 of 1994 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The trial Court recorded the evidence of 5 PWs as against 3 DWs and upon conclusion of trial of the suit he decreed the suit of the plaintiff in full by the judgment and decree dated 7-9-1995 and 13-9-1995 respectively. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree the defendant preferred Family Other Appeal No. 186 of 1995 in the Court of the District Judge, Netrakona who after hearing of the appeal dismissed the same by the impugned judgment and decree and affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial Court in partial modification of the judgment and decree of the trial Court. 

 11. In the result the Rule is made absolute without any order as to costs. The impugned judgment and decree dated 3-6-1996 and 10-6- 1996 respectively passed by the District Judge, Netrakona in Family Other Appeal No.186 of 1995 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 7-9-95 and 13-9-95 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, and Family Court Judge, Mohanganj in Family Suit No. 14 of 1994 decreeing the suit are hereby set aside. The judgment and decree of the trial Court passed in the above mentioned Family suit are also set aside.
